points.form: ちゃう/じゃう, ちゃった/じゃった
points.formation: てしまう becomes ちゃう; でしまう becomes じゃう. Preserve the verb's te-form changes. Past ちゃった/じゃった. Completion or unintended/regretted outcome depends on context.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve full forms and recognise peer contractions. Do not derive from the masu stem or claim every use expresses regret.

points.form: とく/どく and てる/でる
points.location: Japonin, Chiho Kamioka, updated 2026-08-13, sections Te Iru/Te Oku. Niko Niko Japanese, Koyama, 2025-09-17, Parts 2–3.
levels: N4 ておく bridge at Bunpro
Natural conversation; no official level claim
points.formation: ておく→とく, でおく→どく; ている→てる, でいる→でる by dropping い. Past/negative forms follow the contracted auxiliary: といた/といて, てた/てない, でた/でない.
points.teachingChoice: Preparatory とく is different from ongoing/resulting/habitual てる. Keep the source verb sound change; recognise でる from でいる rather than always the dictionary verb 出る.

levels: N5 casual obligation at both publishers
points.formation: Negative base before ない + なきゃ (なければ) or なくちゃ (なくては), often omitting following いけない/ならない/だめ.する→しなきゃ; 来る→こなきゃ.
points.teachingChoice: Affirmative obligation, not prohibition. Named contraction tasks avoid choosing between equivalent なきゃ/なくちゃ. No gender exclusivity is taught.

levels: N3 っけ; N4 かな at both publishers
points.formation: Recall たっけ/だっけ/だったっけ or verb + んだっけ; noun/na-adjective takes だ/だった. Future arrangements can be recalled too. Wondering plain verb/i-adjective + かな; noun/na-adjective + かな without だ in the taught pattern.
points.teachingChoice: Score meaning using explicit prior arrangement vs an unresolved thought. Bunpro prefers expanded nonpast んだっけ and describes bare dictionary+っけ as colloquial; Sensei's table is broad. Teach expanded form, recognise variation, do not insist a recollected event must already be past.

points.form: Affirmative じゃん and explanatory の?
points.location: Maggie Sensei formation/use sections; Tae Kim search-indexed Using じゃん and の vs か; Japonin opening/Te Iru question example.
levels: Casual speech; no current JLPT tag asserted
points.formation: Statement + じゃん presents a point, reaction or shared confirmation; it is not the negative predicate じゃない. Explanatory casual question: plain verb/i-adjective + の?; noun/na-adjective + なの? with rising question delivery.
points.teachingChoice: Use peers, not a blanket politeness rule or an anime-only/gender-only label. Rising の asks about a situation; distinguish it from possessive の and explanatory statement の. Audio signal checks cannot certify question intonation.
